A '''cube''' was a cube-shaped residential unit.<ref name="TAUT">{{LivingForce|Looking In: The Air Up Thaere}}</ref>

Cubes were used as accommodation in residential section of [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zham Hlar]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Xirossk]], a [[Thaereian Intelligence]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] posted to Burnout, lived in one such cube.<ref name="TAUT" />

There were cubes located in the [[resiplex]] apartment complexes of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]], a battle station built by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Architect/Legends|architect]] [[Teela Kaarz]] lived in [[Cube 24556|cube]] number 24556, of [[Resiplex 19]] and [[Sprawl 20]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>
